title: 'Only Ensuring Law & Order': Delhi Police Opposes PIL Alleging Surveillance Of Protesters At Jantar Mantar
description: The Delhi Police on Monday opposed before the Delhi High Court a public interest litigation alleging "continuous surveillance" of peaceful protesters at Jantar Mantar. Appearing for the Delhi Police, Solicitor General of India Tushar Mehta told a Division Bench comprising Chief Justice D.K. Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia that the measures in question were undertaken solely to maintain law and order and did not amount to surveillance or snooping.
